content.comment_body: I'm experiencing issues installing the update from [version_no] to [version_no] on my Mac. When I download the demo and run the setup file, it appears broken and ends up in the trash. My CD for [version_no] works without a problem, but after attempting to update to [version_no], the program starts and closes within a few seconds without displaying the interface, except for a single menu item which quickly disappears. Does anyone have any suggestions on how to resolve this? Thank you for your help. [user_name]
Hello, Could you please share the OS version running on your Mac? Regards,

macOS [version_no]. Interestingly, the problem started after I installed the Dutch language yesterday; previously, I had always used the English version. Before switching, [version_no] worked fine. Now, updating to [version_no] doesn’t work at all, even after completely uninstalling and reinstalling - no improvement. The original [version_no] from DVD continues to function correctly.

Hello [user_name], I suggest installing the most recent driver for the relevant USB/serial interface. Additionally, update to the latest version of Java. After confirming that only [product_name] V7 is on your computer, try applying the update to [version_no] using the steps outlined in the FAQ: [url]. Please let us know if this resolves your issue or if it persists. Greetings, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The main issue described is a failed software update from one version to another on a Mac, resulting in the application not launching after the update. The downloaded installer is described as faulty, and after installation, the program only briefly appears before closing, displaying just a single, fleeting menu item. Reliability of the update process is in question, particularly regarding compatibility and installation procedures on macOS.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects the application to update smoothly and function correctly after the upgrade, regardless of selected system language settings.
